Answer: A
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a large, multicystic mass in the fetal thorax (Figure 1) with a distinct systemic feeding vessel visualized on color Doppler (Figure 2), which is the pathognomonic radiological sign of pulmonary sequestration. While the cysts appear small in this view, the presence of vascular flow definitively rules out CCAM/CPAM (which lacks systemic flow) and confirms the diagnosis of sequestration over other cystic lung lesions.
